name: General Contractor License
description: How to transfer a contractor license between US states.
longDescription: Contractor licensing and reciprocity are set state by state. PermitBridge publishes a contractor transfer page only after checking the requirements against the licensing board's own source.

faqs.question: Which states does California's CSLB offer contractor reciprocity to?
faqs.answer: CSLB's Reciprocity Requirements page lists Arizona, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nevada, and North Carolina, for classifications on that state's reciprocal list. Separately, contractors from any state who passed the NASCLA Commercial General Builders Examination can request an exam waiver for CSLB's General Building classification.

faqs.question: Which states does Florida offer contractor reciprocity to?
faqs.answer: Florida's reciprocity application (DBPR CILB 32) covers applicants from Louisiana, Mississippi, and North Carolina, for General, Building, and Residential contractor licenses only.
